integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] 3D CG, cinematic, wuxia. A low-angle medium shot frames a swordsman in a black robe gathering teal spirit flame along his blade on a ruined temple roof, his brows slamming down and jaw clenched. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at fast speed. [Shot 2] At 00:02.000, he unleashes his ultimate finishing move, a colossal teal crescent slash that tears across the courtyard and strikes the demon square in the chest. For two frames the frame cuts to a black-and-white manga panel with radial speed lines, then one frame of black. A huge explosion engulfs the demon and a shockwave blasts outward, roof tiles rattle loose and lanterns swing. The camera pulls out with large amplitude at fast speed. [Shot 3] At 00:06.000, the demon is hurled backward through a stone wall, and the swordsman settles into a low guard as embers drift down. The camera steadies.
overall_soundscape: A rising hum, a deafening boom, stone cracking, debris pattering.
non_diegetic_music: Low taiko drums building to a single hit.
